mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically leads to increased wage pressures and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased wage pressures.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances following a 3-month increase in HOUST, or HOUST increase does not correlate with broader economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a healthy labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with positive market returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with accommodative monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong job growth, which is a positive indicator for economic expansion and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over a 6-month period signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances following a 6-month increase in GDPC1, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with strong economic growth.
